# mongo-migrate-kit

> MongoDB migrations for Node.js and TypeScript. Run one migration file or all pending ones, roll
> back the last batch, an older batch, the last N files or one file by name, preview any run with a
> dry run, wrap a migration in a transaction, notice files edited after they ran (SHA-256
> checksums), and stop two deploys from running at once with a lock stored in MongoDB. Used through
> the `mmk` CLI or a typed JavaScript API. Can import an existing migrate-mongo history so nothing
> runs twice.

Key facts:
- Package (npm): `mongo-migrate-kit`. Install with `npm install mongo-migrate-kit mongodb`
- CLI command: `mmk`
- Requires Node.js 18+, the `mongodb` driver 5+, and MongoDB server 4.2+. Transactions need a replica set or sharded cluster
- Migration files: JavaScript (ESM or CommonJS) or TypeScript (runs directly on Node 22.18+)
- License: MIT
- Repository: https://github.com/guptasantosh327/mongo-migrate-kit

## Guide (a learning path, in order)

- [Start here](https://mongo-migrate-kit.vercel.app/guide/): What the tool is and the four-step path through the docs
- [Why mongo-migrate-kit?](https://mongo-migrate-kit.vercel.app/guide/why): What it does differently, and a fair comparison with migrate-mongo
- [Quick start](https://mongo-migrate-kit.vercel.app/guide/getting-started): Install, create, run, check and roll back a first migration in five minutes
- [Tutorial: your first migration](https://mongo-migrate-kit.vercel.app/guide/tutorial): A slower walkthrough with a collection, a backfill, a dry run and a rollback
- [How it works](https://mongo-migrate-kit.vercel.app/guide/concepts): The history collection, batches, the lock, checksums and failures, with diagrams
- [Writing migrations](https://mongo-migrate-kit.vercel.app/guide/writing-migrations): The file format, the migration context, CommonJS projects, TypeScript and good habits
- [A normal day with mmk](https://mongo-migrate-kit.vercel.app/guide/workflow): The everyday workflow from writing a migration to rolling back a bad release
- [Configuration](https://mongo-migrate-kit.vercel.app/guide/configuration): Config files, environment variables, flags, secret managers and config errors
- [Deploying and CI](https://mongo-migrate-kit.vercel.app/guide/ci-cd): GitHub Actions, testing migrations on pull requests, Docker, Kubernetes and JSON output
- [Running from your code](https://mongo-migrate-kit.vercel.app/guide/api): runMigrations(), pendingMigrations() and the MigratorKit class
- [Transactions](https://mongo-migrate-kit.vercel.app/guide/transactions): All-or-nothing migrations with useTransaction and session
- [Hooks](https://mongo-migrate-kit.vercel.app/guide/hooks): beforeAll, afterAll, beforeEach, afterEach and onError
- [When something goes wrong](https://mongo-migrate-kit.vercel.app/guide/troubleshooting): The common errors, with real output and fixes
- [Sharing a database](https://mongo-migrate-kit.vercel.app/guide/shared-database): Several repos on one database, one namespace per repo
- [Moving from migrate-mongo](https://mongo-migrate-kit.vercel.app/guide/migrate-mongo): Import an existing migrate-mongo history without running anything twice
- [FAQ](https://mongo-migrate-kit.vercel.app/guide/faq): Common questions about MongoDB migrations with mongo-migrate-kit

## Commands

- [mmk up](https://mongo-migrate-kit.vercel.app/commands/up): Run pending migrations, or one file
- [mmk down](https://mongo-migrate-kit.vercel.app/commands/down): Roll back the last batch, a batch, the last N, or one file
- [mmk redo](https://mongo-migrate-kit.vercel.app/commands/redo): Roll back and re-apply a migration
- [mmk status and list](https://mongo-migrate-kit.vercel.app/commands/status): See what ran and what's pending; --check for CI
- [mmk dry-run](https://mongo-migrate-kit.vercel.app/commands/dry-run): Preview up or down without writing anything
- [mmk create and init](https://mongo-migrate-kit.vercel.app/commands/create): Create migration files and a config file
- [mmk import](https://mongo-migrate-kit.vercel.app/commands/import): Copy a migrate-mongo history (forward-only)
- [mmk unlock](https://mongo-migrate-kit.vercel.app/commands/unlock): Remove a lock left by a crashed run
- [mmk namespace adopt](https://mongo-migrate-kit.vercel.app/commands/namespace): Move a repo's older records into its new namespace
